scheme_name: Safai Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be registered with the State Board for at least 90 days
Must be registered as a beneficiary under Section 10 of the Act
Each worker can receive the benefit only once
Workers receiving benefits under any other parallel State Government scheme are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides medical assistance up to ₹50,000 for serious illnesses such as kidney disease, cancer, sickle‑cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS and paralysis.
